evidence: Modifies `TxIndex::FindTx` in `src/index/txindex.cpp` (+37/-17) to throw on disk read or corruption errors rather than returning null.
rationale: Prevents `TxIndex::FindTx` from silently treating index read failures or corruption as a missing transaction. As noted in the commit message, "a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception."
